title: 7.6 What I Like to Do
unit_title: Unit 7: My Body, My Day and My Free Time
unit_outcome: Name the body and clothes, say how you feel and what the weather is like, talk about free time, make plans with friends and ask someone to repeat.
goal: Say what you like doing with gern: Ich spiele gern Fußball. Spielst du gern Fußball?
grammar_function: Ich + verb + gern (+ thing). Verb + du gern ...? Nein, ich + verb + nicht gern ...
speaking_outcome: Say what you like to do.
